title: 第22章 鱼死不能復生第23章 教我炼丹
content_zh:
龙血丹的主要功效是增强气血造化之力。
说白了就是强化骨髓，增加骨髓的造血能力。
武者修炼，非常消耗气血，这龙血丹对武者而言，称得上是极品。
但对修仙者来说其实意义不大。
修仙之人，讲究一个风姿縹緲，来去无踪，不会跟武者一样与人肉搏血战，那种战斗在修仙者看来是上不了台面的。
楚夏不在乎这些。
能对自己有帮助的丹药，那都是好东西。
增强气血之力，他的体力会更加充沛，精力会更加旺盛。
在没有成为真正的修仙者以前，这些提升还是会有很大帮助的。
隨著龙血丹开始发挥作用，楚夏感觉浑身上下的骨头都酥酥麻麻的。
有点痒，但又挠不到。
这种感觉还是挺让人难受的。
好在持续的时间不久。
一刻钟后，骨髓开始发热。
楚夏可以清晰感觉到，自己的精力得到了提升。
副作用就是，他现在莫名有些亢奋，完全无法进入修炼状態。
脑海中不由自主的浮现出在祖龙禁地的记忆。
然后又想到昨天在这间地下室里发生的事情。
想到了夏紫萱柔若无骨的小手，想到她嫣红的唇。
楚夏突然有些怀念之前的贤者模式了。

现在他根本静不下心去修炼。
只能隨手拿起一本夏紫萱收藏的言情画本翻阅起来。
书名很怪，叫《仙师请留宿》
……
“楚夏，你个混蛋！！！“
大清早的，楚夏还在地下室看书，夏紫萱突然怒气冲冲的跑了进来。
“你怎么骂人啊。”
楚夏没好气道。
昨晚他没有去夜袭夏紫萱，可是付出了很大的毅力，她怎么还生气了。
“你是不是把我养在后园的锦鲤给烤吃了！！”
夏紫萱眼睛瞪的老大，气势汹汹的质问道。
楚夏点了点头。
content_en:
The main function of Dragon Blood Pill is to enhance the power of Qi and blood.
To put it bluntly, it strengthens the bone marrow and increases its hematopoietic ability.
The practice of a warrior consumes a lot of energy and blood. This dragon blood pill is considered to be the best for warriors.
But it actually doesn’t mean much to cultivators.
Immortal cultivators pay attention to a person who has an ethereal appearance and comes and goes without a trace. They will not engage in bloody battles with human beings like warriors. Such battles are not worthy of the stage in the eyes of immortal cultivators.
Chu Xia didn't care about this.
Any elixir that can help you is a good thing.
By enhancing the power of Qi and blood, his physical strength will be more abundant and his energy will be more vigorous.
Before becoming a true immortal cultivator, these improvements will still be of great help.
As the Dragon Blood Pill began to take effect, Chu Xia felt that all the bones in her body were numb.
It's a little itchy, but I can't scratch it.
This feeling is quite uncomfortable.
Fortunately it didn't last long.
After a quarter of an hour, the bone marrow began to heat up.
Chu Xia could clearly feel that her energy had been improved.
The side effect is that he is now inexplicably excited and unable to enter the cultivation state at all.
The memory of being in the Ancestral Dragon Forbidden Land appeared in my mind involuntarily.
Then I thought about what happened in this basement yesterday.
I thought of Xia Zixuan's soft, boneless hands and her bright red lips.
Chu Xia suddenly missed the previous sage mode.
Now he simply can't calm down and practice.
I could only pick up a romance picture book collected by Xia Zixuan and read through it.
The title of the book is very strange, it's called "The Immortal Master Please Stay Overnight"
…
"Chu Xia, you bastard!!!"
Early in the morning, Chu Xia was still reading in the basement, when Xia Zixuan suddenly ran in angrily.
"Why are you swearing?"
Chu Xia said angrily.
He didn't go to attack Xia Zixuan at night last night, but he put in a lot of perseverance, so why was she still angry?
“Did you roast and eat the koi I kept in the back garden?!”
Xia Zixuan's eyes widened and she asked aggressively.
Chu Xia nodded.
